title: Slime IO 2
description: Roll, absorb and grow in this fast .io arena. Eat smaller blobs, dodge bigger ones, and climb the leaderboard before the round ends.
content:
How to play

  • Move with the mouse or WASD — your blob follows your pointer.
  • Run into smaller blobs to absorb them and gain mass.
  • Avoid anything larger than you; one touch ends the run.

Tips

Hug the edge of the arena early on. Most players rush the centre, which is where the biggest blobs farm. Stay on the rim until you have enough mass to compete.

Playable in any modern browser. No download, no account, no install.

title: Miner Tycoon
description: Dig deeper, hire crews and turn a single pickaxe into an automated mining empire. Idle progress keeps running while the tab is closed.
content:
How to play

  • Click the rock face to mine ore.
  • Spend ore on better drills, then on crew members who mine for you.
  • Unlock new shafts as your output grows.

Tips

Do not upgrade the pickaxe past level 5 — the first crew member gives a bigger return per coin, and you can buy two of them for the same price.

title: Super Idle Farm
description: A calm farming idle game. Plant crops, collect coins passively, and expand your land plot by plot without ever needing to install anything.
content:
How to play

  • Click a field to plant a crop.
  • Harvest when the bar fills, then spend the coins on upgrades.
  • Offline progress continues at half rate.

Perfect for Chromebooks

The game is light enough to run on school hardware and needs no plugins or extensions.

title: Robot Battle X
description: Build a mech, pick a chassis and fight short arena rounds. Fast rounds, quick respawns, and a weapon tree that rewards aggressive play.
content:
How to play

  • Choose a chassis: light for speed, heavy for armor.
  • Fire with left click, boost with space.
  • Collect scrap after each round to unlock weapons.

title: Cookie Kingdom
description: A clicker with a light kingdom-building layer. Bake cookies, reinvest them into bakeries and watch the numbers roll up.
content:
How to play

Click the big cookie for the first few minutes, then buy your first bakery as soon as it unlocks. Everything after that is reinvestment.

title: Space Defender
description: Wave-based space shooter. Hold the line with turrets, upgrade shields between waves, and push back the swarm.
content:
How to play

  • Move with arrow keys, shoot automatically.
  • Spend credits between waves on turrets and shields.

title: Pocket Racer
description: Two-player split-screen racing on one keyboard. Pick a car, learn the track and settle it locally — no account needed.
content:
Controls

  • Player 1: WASD
  • Player 2: arrow keys

Runs on one screen with two players, which makes it the easiest pick when two people are on the same laptop.

title: Dragon Clicker
description: Hatch eggs, feed dragons and send them on passive runs. A slow-burn clicker with a collection loop on top.
content:
How to play

Tap the nest to speed up hatching. Each dragon adds passive income; rarity decides the multiplier.

title: Tower Tactics
description: A compact tower defence game. Place towers on fixed pads, then adapt when the wave mix changes.
content:
How to play

  • Pick a pad, buy a tower.
  • Sell a tower to refund 70% if the wave demands a different damage type.

title: Zombie Craft
description: Survive the night, craft barricades, and hold out until rescue. Short runs, permanent upgrades.
content:
How to play

  • Collect wood and metal during the day.
  • Build barricades before dark, then defend.

title: Neon Drift
description: Endless drift racer with a synthwave palette. Chain drifts to build a multiplier before the timer runs out.
content:
How to play

Hold space to drift. The longer you hold the chain without hitting a wall, the higher the multiplier.

title: Auto Garden
description: Place sprinklers and harvesters on a small plot, then let the garden run itself while you are away.
content:
How to play

Buy a sprinkler first — growth speed compounds faster than plot size in the first hour.
